text: Isn't the sea beautiful?
zh: 大海很美，不是吗？

text: May I help you, boy?
zh: 有什么事吗，小子？

text: Oh, how I miss being at sea.
zh: 唉，我真怀念在海上的日子。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Why aren't you on a ship?
zh: 你为什么不在船上？

text: Do you want to live in the capital?
zh: 你想住到王都去吗？

text: What is there to know about the area here?
zh: 这一带有什么值得了解的？

text: I could find your hat.
zh: 我可以帮你找回帽子。

text: I found your old hat.
zh: 我找到了你的旧帽子。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: I am just an old sailor, boy.
zh: 我只是个老水手，小子。

text: There's not much to know.
zh: 没什么好说的。

text: Look at me...
zh: 你看看我……

text:
I am far too old to be on adventures again.
A few years ago I retired and now I am spending my time here in this ol' hut.
zh:
我已经太老了，没法再去冒险了。
几年前我退了休，如今就在这间破旧的小屋里打发日子。

text: At least there is a great view on the sea.
zh: 至少这里看海的风景不错。

text: To move even farther away from the sea?
zh: 搬到离大海更远的地方去？

text:
Ha!
Of course not!
zh:
哈！
当然不想！

text: The cliffs are called Marin Cliffs, but I forgot where the name comes from.
zh: 这片悬崖叫马林悬崖，不过这名字的由来我已经忘了。

text: To the east is the #:Academy of some ol' wizards:#.
zh: 东边是#:一帮老巫师的学院:#。

text: Also, the #:harbor:# lies nearby, but the ships no longer come regularly.
zh: 另外，#:港口:#就在附近，不过船已经不常来了。

text: And be aware of the region west of here. There's a small tunnel leading to a lake with an #:ancient tower:#, but strange people settled there.
zh: 还有，当心此地以西的那片区域。有条小隧道通向一座湖，湖边有座#:古塔:#，但那里住着一群古怪的人。

text:
I once visited the tower and just barely made it back alive.
While runnin' for my old life, I even lost my good hat, ha ha!
zh:
我去过一次那座塔，差点没能活着回来。
拼了老命逃跑的时候，连我那顶好帽子都跑丢了，哈哈！

text:
Well, that would be something.
Just make sure to make it back alive!
zh:
哦，那可就太好了。
只是你可得活着回来！

text:
Look at that!
This truly is my hat!
zh:
瞧瞧啊！
这真是我的帽子！

text: Here, take some of the gold I found on my adventures when I was a captain.
zh: 给，拿上这些金币吧，是我当船长闯荡时攒下的。
